created: Company registered. The access key was sent to the administrative email.
name_taken: An active company with that legal name already exists.
admin_email_taken: That email already belongs to another Monkey account.
dedicated_not_available: Dedicated databases are not available yet. Register the company without one for now.
deactivated: Company archived. No access or evaluations until it is permanently deleted.
confirmation_mismatch: The legal name entered does not match the company's.
archive_expired: The archive period has ended: the company is about to be deleted and can no longer be reactivated.
max_users_below_current: The limit cannot be lower than the accounts already counted: deactivate some first.
